# Presentation Sage

> YAML-driven slide editor with PPTX/HTML/Marp export

- Live: https://slides.neorgon.com/
- Part of the Neorgon tool suite (free, no signup, runs in your browser): https://neorgon.com/
- Keywords: slides, yaml, pptx, marp, export

## Files for agents

- [Deck schema](https://slides.neorgon.com/CLAUDE.md): Every slide type, the density rules, and the flow audit checklist
- [Worked example](https://slides.neorgon.com/template.yaml): A complete deck that validates clean — start from this
- [Deck validator](https://slides.neorgon.com/validate.mjs): Density checks without the player: node validate.mjs deck.yaml (standalone — fetches the player's own rules when run outside a checkout)

## More Neorgon tools

- [Neorgon hub](https://neorgon.com/): Browse and launch every tool from one page.
